tolerance: approximately +/-2x on absolute bytes; exact on the scaling exponent
notes: The HashMap key is the same String instance as the sku field, so it is counted once.
5000 rows is 0.8 MB and 2000000 rows is 332 MB -- a 400x span. That ratio is why an unbounded cache always passes in development and fails at the customer.
332 MB here is anonymous memory: it can be compressed into zRAM but never dropped, which is what MemoryLimiter:AnonSwap kills for.
